theme.strategy: Hybrid Contextual Theme. The portfolio utilizes 'Dark Theme Bookends' (Hero and Get In Touch sections are immersive dark mode) to create a cinematic opening and closing, while the core content sections (About, Experience, Projects) and the entire Admin Dashboard run on an ultra-clean, 'Glass/Clean' Light Theme.
theme.emotional_tone: Elegant, precise, creative, and strictly professional (Behance top-tier quality).

dark_bookends.description: Deep void black with high-contrast electric blue and purple gradients for hero/footer.

project_accents.description: Used strictly for project-specific highlights, tags, and call-to-actions within the Selected Projects section.

typography.strategy: Since Roboto is standard, we must use extreme contrast to make it feel premium. Headings MUST be 'font-black' or 'font-bold' with 'tracking-tight'. Body must be 'font-normal' with 'leading-relaxed'.

motion.page_transition: Smooth fade and slide up using framer-motion (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
motion.scroll_reveal: Sections should fade in on scroll.
motion.rule: Sedikit tapi berkelas (Minimal but classy, not overwhelming).

layouts.hero: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Centered or asymmetric layout on #050505 background. Large 'Hello And Welcome To My PORTOFOLIO.' heading. Include a glowing gradient badge for role, experience range, and a prominent 'Selected Project' CTA.
layouts.about: Bento-box grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6). Profile photo spans 4 cols, Bio spans 8 cols. Dedicated cards for Hard Skills, Soft Skills, and Tools (Figma/Corel/AE/Blender) with icons.
layouts.experience: Vertical timeline layout with clear connection lines. Clean typography.
layouts.projects: Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8). Project cards must have cover images, category tags (using the red palette), and title.
layouts.project_detail: Immersive page. Massive cover image, overview section, role/tools grid. Must include a 'Color Palette' section with hex swatches and a 'Typography' section, followed by a screenshot gallery and external links.
layouts.get_in_touch: Reverts to Dark Theme. Massive typography for contact, static info, CTA mailto, social links, and a 'Download CV' button. Acts as a cinematic bookend.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Standard SaaS layout. Sidebar navigation (fixed) + main content area. Data tables for CRUD operations. Settings page for CV upload and SEO.

components_strategy.public_site: Use pure HTML/Tailwind + framer-motion for maximum layout flexibility and creative overlapping.
components_strategy.admin_site: Use Shadcn/UI (Tables, Forms, Dialogs, Inputs, Buttons) heavily customized to match the light clean theme.

profile_photo.description: Professional UX Designer portrait with glasses, arms crossed, clean background.

libraries.icons: lucide-react for Admin, @phosphor-icons/react for Public site (install via yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
libraries.animation: framer-motion for page transitions and hover effects.
libraries.scrolling: lenis for smooth scrolling on public pages (install via yarn add @studio-freight/react-lenis).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark/Light hybrid theme structure.
Implement the 'Get In Touch' section with the exact same background and vibe as the 'Hero' section.
Use framer-motion for smooth page and card transitions.
For the Project Detail page, ensure you build specific UI components for 'Color Palette' (showing circular or square hex swatches) and 'Typography' (showing 'Aa' and font weights).
Ensure 'Roboto' is set globally in index.css.
Admin panel must be fully protected by JWT auth (mock if needed but build the UI flow).

universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based naming.
universal_guidelines.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
universal_guidelines.borders: Never use pure transparent backgrounds on overlays. Use glassmorphism.
universal_guidelines.animations: Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
